attributes.title: Split view
attributes.lede: A value read off another element’s measurement.

lesson.concept: Geometry can be a measured dependency
lesson.why: The content's left offset is derived from the sidebar's before and after widths. A property function expresses that relationship without maintaining a duplicate numeric width in application state.
lesson.experiment: Expand and collapse the sidebar while it moves. Inspect whether the content edge remains aligned with the measured sidebar edge.
lesson.pitfall: A hard-coded offset becomes stale when text, viewport or sidebar content changes.
lesson.combine: Combine with camera framing when the available reading area changes with a panel.
